title: Choose the Club shell and Overview composition
question: All three options use Nova's established Fieldhouse Wayfinding system and the agreed role-shaped routes. Choose the composition that should govern issue #201.

options.label: Stacked Waypoints
options.lineage: A fieldhouse route board joining three successive orientation points
options.thesis: Club identity, current season, and active work read as one connected vertical handoff.
options.viewport: A stable Club directory frames a broad hall where identity leads into a vertical Season-to-Active-Work route.
options.risk: The route can imply a wizard unless every marker is written as orientation rather than progress.

options.label: Operations Ledger
options.lineage: A club register with one identity heading and two authoritative ledger rows
options.thesis: The Overview behaves like a compact register: who the club is, which season is current, and where work continues.
options.viewport: A full-width identity strip sits above a disciplined two-row ledger for Current season and Active work.
options.risk: The compact register can feel overly administrative if hierarchy and breathing room are too restrained.

options.label: Stewardship Wall
options.lineage: A fieldhouse directory wall opening onto two neighboring work bays
options.thesis: A strong club sign anchors the hall while season and active work occupy distinct, equally truthful bays.
options.viewport: The local directory and club sign establish identity; Current season and Active work sit side by side below it and stack on mobile.
options.risk: The paired bays can drift toward a generic dashboard card grid if their shared fieldhouse structure is weakened.
